text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Down the slope they go!!
Here comes the decisive moment!!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oryaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!
Hyaaaaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(――Helios-san, Zephyr-san,
and Nature-san.)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I will engrave it into all of you.
My running... as I am now!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (The timing to make my move is――――NOW!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Ikuno Dictus!
Ikuno Dictus extends her stride more and more!
She takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Ikuno Dictus crosses the finish line in first place!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I won...!! I did it...!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(My journey up to this day...
I proved that it all led to this...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real!? That's super rare!
Total emotional vibes, for real!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Even this breeze feels like a blessing—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
Running against her for real, she really is strong...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You really are incredible, Ikuno...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
…………Following your lead,
maybe I'll run a whole bunch
and steadily grow stronger too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan A
text_block_list.text: Congrats on two consecutive wins starting from the Queen Elizabeth II Cuuuup!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Great work out there--!!
Thank you so much for coming back safe and sound--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
choice_data_list: This sight was created by your running.
This is the sight your running created.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup and the Mile CS.
Victories in both races proved
Ikuno Dictus's strength—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running, along with her self-management, is now being widely praised.
As her trainer, I couldn't be prouder.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
......No.
That is not true.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It is "us."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Because you and I were together...
We were able to come this far.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I take Ikuno Dictus's outstretched hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them raised their arms before their fans, openly displaying their joy at seizing the glory of victory—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus! Trainer!
You both worked so hard! That was amazing--!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Fan D
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for running for us!!
I'll keep cheering you on forever--!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The comforting words offered to me were gentle and warm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that we can cherish the feelings spreading right here and now,
I will continue running alongside Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Burning the dazzling sight into my memory,
and feeling the firm grip of her hand squeezing back,
I made a solemn vow with Ikuno Dictus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping everything up, just as I was about to
head back home with Ikuno Dictus—
Ikuno~, are you still there~?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...! That voice, Teio-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Sorry for catching you just as you're heading home!
I just really wanted to ask you this before the day ends."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, congratulations on winning the Mile CS!
That run was so typical of you, Ikuno—it was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much.
Going out of your way to come watch me...—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...So, what is this 'request'?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, about that...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Before that,
there's something I need to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ......I'm going to run in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Carrying the 'never give up' spirit
that Turbo and Ikuno taught me that day,
I gave it everything I had!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So...
The earliest race I can make a comeback in is the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I want to show the fans who cheer for me
and everyone who helped me make my comeback
my coolest, best running out there!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And so, here's the favor I wanted to ask—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I want you to run in the Arima Kinen too, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...To you, who have been running non-stop
ever since making your debut—"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "All the time you've spent building yourself up... I want to challenge every bit of it!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Teio-san—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The light in Ikuno Dictus's eyes always speaks of her resolve far more eloquently than words ever could.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And as her Trainer,
I always want to respect her wishes."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you for the invitation.
What you said earlier made me so happy."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Let us settle this.
At the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"With every hoofprint I have built along the way...
I will face you, now that you have returned."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's more like it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, in an unexpected turn of events, it was decided that we would aim for the Arima Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh?!
Nature and Machitan are running in the Arima Kinen too?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~ Well, that's how it is~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Things just kind of
lined up nicely, or something like that—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Who would've thought I'd get to run alongside Teio for her comeback race~!
Nature is thrilled about this too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I really am glad. Seriously.
I'd always wanted to face them head-on someday, after all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whaat!? Nature, do you have a cold!?
Do you have a fever!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hey, what the heck is that supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No fair, no fair, no fair, no fair!!
Turbo wanted to run with Teio toooo!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. I'm sure Teio-san
will continue running even after the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even if we can't this year,
I'm sure we'll definitely race with Turbo-san next year.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Eeeh! Turbo wants to run right now~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...But—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: I can't help it this time, so I'll let everyone else have it! Turbo's gonna get way stronger in the meantime!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno! You have permission to leave Teio
in the dust on Turbo's behalf, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
I will do my best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the year draws to a close, dreams gather once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen was drawing near.
